What’s Included in a 2026 Wedding Decoration Package in Bangalore?

While every celebration is unique, most wedding decorators in Bangalore offer tiered packages that scale based on design complexity and the type of floral materials used. Whether you are hosting an intimate Muhurtham or a grand reception at a luxury resort, here are samples of what you can typically expect in 2026:

Package Inclusions Depending on Venue & Budget

1. Basic Decoration Packages
Best for: Intimate home-based functions, Haldi, or Mehendi ceremonies.
Entrance Decor: Simple floral arches or traditional marigold (Genda) hangings with mango leaf torans.
Standard Stage Setup: Fabric draping with a clean floral backdrop and a traditional sofa or two-seater.
Essential Seating: Standard chair covers with tie-backs and basic table linens.
Focal Lighting: Basic LED floodlights to ensure the couple is well-lit for photography.

2. Mid-Range Decoration Packages
Best for: Boutique resorts, community halls, and mid-scale hotel weddings.
Customized Theme: Selection of modern palettes (Pastels, Royal Gold, or "Garden City" Greenery).
Grand Entry Decor: Themed walkways featuring props like brass lamps, bells, or rustic wooden elements.
Floral Mandap/Altar: A semi-customized structure using high-quality local flowers like jasmine, carnations, and tuberoses.
Ambient Lighting: "Fairy light" canopies, warm mood lighting, and Decorative lanterns.
Guest Experience: Fully styled seating and simple, elegant tabletop centerpieces.

3. Premium & Luxury Decoration Packages
Best for: Heritage palaces, luxury 5-star hotels, and destination weddings.
Bespoke Design & 3D Renders: Complete venue transformation with personalized mood boards and architectural layouts.
Luxury Mandap: Intricately carved stone-style or glass structures featuring exotic blooms like Orchids, Hydrangeas, and Calla Lilies.
Personalized Installations: Custom-built photo booths, monogrammed floral walls, and suspended "floral cloud" ceilings.
Professional Lighting Design: Crystal chandeliers, architectural uplighting, and "intelligent" lighting synced to the Sangeet performances.
Full Venue Styling: Total transformation including luxury lounge furniture, ornate designer bars, and fine-dining tablescapes.

FAQs
What is the cost of wedding decorators in Bangalore?

The average wedding Decorator cost in Bangalore for 2026 starts at ₹50,000 for basic setups and can exceed ₹10 Lakhs for luxury weddings. On average, mid-range couples spend between ₹2 Lakhs and ₹5 Lakhs on comprehensive floral and stage Decor for their main ceremony and reception.

Can wedding decorators customize themes?

Yes, most professional wedding Decorators in Bangalore offer full theme customization. Popular 2026 trends include Royal South Indian Temple themes, Minimalist Modern Garden aesthetics, and Boho-Traditional fusion. Decorators use custom 3D renders to help couples visualize their unique stage and mandap designs before the event.

Do wedding decorators provide services outside Bangalore?

Many top-rated Bangalore Decorators travel for destination weddings to nearby locations like Coorg, Mysore, and Chikmagalur, as well as interstate spots like Goa. Booking an outstation Decorator usually involves a travel fee and logistical surcharges ranging from ₹1 Lakh to ₹3 Lakhs.

How much do wedding decorators typically charge?

Wedding Decorators typically charge based on venue size, material quality, and design complexity. A standard pricing model involves a fixed rental fee for props plus the variable cost of fresh flowers and labor. In 2026, Decorators often account for 15%–25% of the total wedding budget.

 What is the difference between a wedding decorator and a wedding planner?

Wedding Decorators focus solely on the aesthetic and visual elements like flowers, lighting, and stage setup.
Wedding Planners are project managers who handle everything from budget tracking and vendor negotiations to guest logistics and event timelines.

Do wedding decorators in Bangalore handle destination weddings?

Yes, several destination wedding Decorators in Bangalore specialize in managing logistics for remote venues. They coordinate the transport of specialized props and source local flowers to ensure the premium wedding Decor standards of the city are maintained at any location.

How far in advance should I book a wedding decorator in Bangalore?

For peak wedding seasons (typically November to March in 2026) and high-demand Muhurtham dates, it is highly recommended to book your decorator at least 4 to 6 months in advance. High-end decorators are often fully committed half a year out. Also, if you’re planning a midweek event or an intimate home function, a 2 to 3-month lead time is usually enough to lock in your vision.

What is included in a wedding decoration package in Bangalore?

A standard Bangalore wedding Decoration package typically includes:
Entrance Decor: Grand arches and floral walkways.
Stage/Mandap: The central ritual or reception backdrop.
Seating & Draping: Chair styling and fabric installations.
Centerpieces: Tabletop floral or prop arrangements.
Can I find a wedding decorator for a small function in Bangalore?

Yes, there is a growing market for intimate wedding decorators in Bangalore. For smaller functions like Home-based Haldi or Mehendi, you can find specialized "micro-Decor" packages starting as low as ₹15,000 to ₹30,000.

How to book the perfect wedding decorator in Bangalore?

To find the best wedding Decorator in Bangalore, start by checking reviews on platforms like The Wedding Company. Always review their "real wedding" portfolio (not just stock photos), confirm if they are on your venue’s panel of approved vendors.
